          'dogs chod pa tshad ma yin kyang rtags la mi rten pas rjes dpag ni ma yin | 'on kyang rjes dpag tshad mas drangs pas de'i tshad mar gzhag_go zhes gsungs pa la 'di mi rigs te |

             de ltar na rjes su skyes pa'i nges shes dang dran pa'i rnam rtog 'ga' zhig kyang rjes dpag tshad mar thal des drangs pa'i <expan>phyir ro</expan> | </seg></TEI>
